name: sessions
description: Lets a Claude Code session start separate, full Claude Code sessions and talk to them

launcher.title: How new sessions start
launcher.description: bg: a background session you can open with claude attach. tmux: an interactive session in a tmux window. headless: a claude -p process that logs to a file.

stopAfterMinutes.title: Stop idle sessions after (minutes)
stopAfterMinutes.description: A background session started here that sits idle this long is stopped to free memory; messaging it wakes it. 0 never stops one.
